items.prompt: Which sentence says 'I get up at seven'?

choices.rationale: Correct: に follows the specific time and 起きます is affirmative.
を marks direct objects, not a wake-up time.
ません makes the action negative.

items.explanation: Correct: に follows the specific time and 起きます is affirmative.

choices.rationale: に is not the direct-object particle here.
Correct: water is the object marked by を; 飲みます means drink.
読みます means read, not drink.

items.explanation: Correct: water is the object marked by を; 飲みます means drink.

items.prompt: What does 本を読みません mean?

choices.rationale: 読みます would be affirmative; ません changes polarity.

choices.text: I do not read a book.
choices.rationale: Correct: 読みません is the polite negative of read.

choices.text: I do not write a book.
choices.rationale: 書きません means do not write; 読みません means do not read.

items.explanation: Correct: 読みません is the polite negative of read.

毎晩 means every evening.
昨日 means yesterday, not a recurring morning.

items.explanation: Correct: 毎朝（まいあさ） means every morning.

items.prompt: Choose the correct polite negative of 食べます.

choices.rationale: ました is affirmative past tense.
Correct: 食べません is polite nonpast negative.
ます is affirmative nonpast.

items.explanation: Correct: 食べません is polite nonpast negative.

items.prompt: Which sentence means 'I go to school at nine'?

choices.text: 九時に学校へ行きます。
choices.rationale: Correct: に marks nine o'clock, へ the destination, and 行きます means go.

choices.text: 九時を学校へ行きます。
choices.rationale: を cannot mark the time in this construction.

choices.text: 九時に学校を読みます。
choices.rationale: 読みます means read and does not express going to school.

items.explanation: Correct: に marks nine o'clock, へ the destination, and 行きます means go.

items.prompt: Which sentence naturally describes a repeated habit?

choices.text: 昨日七時に起きました。
choices.rationale: 昨日 and ました report a past event.
Correct: 毎日 plus polite nonpast describes a regular routine.

choices.text: 昨日七時に起きませんでした。
choices.rationale: 昨日 and ませんでした report a past negative event.

items.explanation: Correct: 毎日 plus polite nonpast describes a regular routine.

items.prompt: Which sentence says 'I do not watch television at night'?

choices.rationale: 見ます is affirmative, so it says I watch TV.

choices.text: 夜はテレビを飲みません。
choices.rationale: 飲みません means do not drink, not do not watch.

choices.text: 夜はテレビを見ません。
choices.rationale: Correct: 見ません is polite negative of 見ます.

items.explanation: Correct: 見ません is polite negative of 見ます.
